laterMeeting.routing: Play saved outcome callback, then its matching followupByOutcome (not the generic nodes). Each choice has a written B reply and stored lastFollowupOutcome; no world action or numeric effect is implied. Generic nodes remain fallback only for missing/unknown memory.

proposedMemoryContract.scope: Map to v0.4 pendingArc, memoryFacts, activeFactIdsByTopic, followUpHooks and atomic choice receipts, not a parallel runner. Earlier simplified fields are semantic requirements only.
perCat: lastFollowupOutcome (does not erase first arc outcome)
rules: Read the last COMPLETED conversation before updating current state. Closing early records the actual early outcome.
Save/Continue must not reset binding, reroll traits or overwrite prior outcome with an unfinished conversation.
Callbacks only for the matching arc/revision/outcome and same live cat. Missing or incompatible memory uses neutral baseline.
Player promises are remembered words, not automatically fulfilled world actions. No implied shared hunt, resource, membership or courtship.
Personality only selects voice, not stored truth or acceptance. Priority aggression high, then sociability high/low, then baseline; sparse variants fall back per node.

Later meeting plays the matching saved callback, then its own short follow-up tree, never the introductory tree. Save its own outcome without erasing first arc outcome. Subsequent repetitions need used-content suppression and a baseline, not an endless generated dialogue claim.

v0.4 supersedes single-terminal-effect suggestion: commit each chosen fact/intent once under its atomic receipt; first improve/day and absolute-delta cap are engine tunables. No raw numeric rewards authored here.

Use proposedOutcomeEffects as §11.3a mirror: terminal effects only, promise resolution separate once within absolute10 cap. Each choice+facts+next node persists atomically; terminal receipt also scoped by run/cat/arc-instance/outcome. Proposed numbers are not approved balance.

fixed: Only verified saved identity, age/stage, faction, portrait and rolled traits are character facts.
This arc introduces no named relatives, scars, prior tragedy, territorial rights or fixed historical biography.
Statements about company and trust are preferences expressed in this conversation, retained as conversation facts, not a new personality reroll.
notEstablished: No physical joint-hunt event, predator sighting, food transfer, mate bond or pride membership.

acceptance: Company → quiet → return_quiet produces quiet_company; same cat later offers Another quiet walk.
Curious → hunt → alone produces prefers_solo_hunts, not a shared hunt memory.
Company → press → repair produces repaired_pressure; dismiss produces dismissed_boundary.
Early leave never becomes completed walk; give-space never becomes rejection of all company.
Save at company, Continue, choose quiet and finish: same cast/traits/portrait, same branch, one terminal consequence.
Reload after completion: recap uses same outcome without replaying consequences.
Different cat or missing memory never receives the first cat’s callback.
Next-day recap does not restart the introductory tree; repeated-meeting content selection needs an explicit tested fallback.

Later choices differ by remembered outcome: quiet company can become talk; boundary pressure prompts renewed negotiation; solitary hunting can be clarified as not rejecting all company. These are playable follow-ups, not only different greetings.

proofSequence.status: DRAFT adapter of existing hunting-interest / quiet-company / boundary-repair content. Overrides generic introductory loop for this one-cat proof.
entryRules: Meeting1 reuses slice.meeting.loner greet/pass/drive unchanged. Greet may continue into this topic; pass/drive do not silently complete it.
Each listed beat is one choice plus its authored response. Neutral leave/pause is available at every beat and preserves the unfinished cursor, not a completed answer.
3 core beats per completed meeting; do not pad aggressive cats beyond their proposed 3-beat limit. Optional extra dialogue only with validated remaining beat budget.
Seek out access/cooldowns and side-slot costs are engine-owned proposed tunables. No extra calendar tick per beat.
Only actual committed share can mark kept. Missing kill, absence or hazard interruption stays pending, never broken. Explicit refusal can mark broken once.
Call share only after today’s successful hunt and before any hunt resource has been consumed; Flint validates actual engine support. No free inventory or double promise/share bonus.

branches.pending: Use resolution meeting again without recharging prior facts, not confiding or blame. A resumed cursor remains the same instance; a later fresh meeting has its own slot charge.
branches.no_promise: Use existing trust/quiet-company followupByOutcome with its actual saved stance; no invented promise, confiding reward or accusation.

factMapping: Engine mints factId/sourceChoiceKey/absDay/sequence. Topic and stance ids above are author-supplied, not inferred from prose.
Keep original promise fact and terminal state history; no log-pruning loss of receipt or promise.
Confiding is a new conversation disclosure about company, not a rerolled personality or canon biography. Use sociability/aggression voice variants without erasing the recorded state.
First proof may pin a fixture for tests, but normal-play ln05 retains its actual generated personality. Never force a friendly trait to make a branch work.
gate: Three meetings retain same ln05 identity and generated traits.
Kept share unlocks confiding; explicit broken promise offers repair instead.
No kill, delayed meeting, leaving or hazard does not break a promise.
No promise path never receives promise recall.
Save before share has pending choice/no reward; save after has kept state and one share reward.
Save/Continue at every beat preserves cursor, presented branch, previous facts and once-only proposed needs charge.

proofProfile.meeting1: Existing three-choice-deep authored graph. quiet_company creates a return_quiet promise ONLY via return_quiet, not via respect at space.
proofProfile.meeting2: Matching saved callback plus followupByOutcome. Only a non-leave opening commitment fulfils return_quiet. Free Leave leaves it pending. Other histories preserve actual original outcome.

proofProfile.calendar: Use agreed legal D/D+2/D+4 availability, not forced encounter dates or a time skip. Seek out/main-action and one side-slot costs remain Tundra tunables.

proposedOutcomeEffects.status: Mirror of §11.3a proposals, not approved balance. Engine applies once at terminal outcome; no per-node talk rewards.
proposedOutcomeEffects.conditionalOverride: need_words at remembered dismissed_boundary yields -5 for boundary_difference; not -5 plus another base effect. Other boundary_difference cases stay0.
proposedOutcomeEffects.promise: return_quiet pending only at quiet_walk.return_quiet. Kept only on a later same-cat non-leave opening commitment, +5 once within absolute10 cap; receipt runId/catId/promiseFactId. proposedOutcomeEffects.charging: Opening leave/later_left: zero affinity/needs, no slot/cooldown. Other opening commitment: needs -3/-2/-1 once, stamps slot and cooldown; resume never recharges.
proposedOutcomeEffects.newOutcomes: Third-meeting outcomes default0 until Tundra maps them. No automatically awarded reward for unlocking confiding.

thirdMeeting.routing: Choose active committed fact; never infer from affinity. Priority ongoing boundary repair, then confirmed kept return_quiet plus quiet_renewed, then neutral fallback. Original facts/history remain intact; newer explicit stance supersedes active topic only.
